context_requirements: Expression of S1PR2 and/or P2RY10 on the cell line
Functional G12/13- or Gi-coupled lysophospholipid receptor signaling
Serum or lysophospholipid ligands present in the assay medium
Intact downstream MAPK/ROCK/YAP pathways for transcriptional output
falsifiers: No change in any of the proximal immediate-early genes (EGR1, FOS, JUN, CCL2, CXCL2, PTGS2) at 6 h in any line
No reduction in proliferation or cell-cycle genes at 24 h in any line
Strong and uniform transcriptional response across all nine lines, including lines lacking S1PR2/P2RY10 expression
A response pattern indistinguishable from generic cytotoxicity without receptor-dependent early genes
